versions.subject: Rule: Suspicious scripting in a WMI consumer
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 20
    Destination:
        - '*new-object system.net.webclient).downloadstring(*'
        - '*new-object system.net.webclient).downloadfile(*'
        - '*new-object net.webclient).downloadstring(*'
        - '*new-object net.webclient).downloadfile(*'
        - '* iex(*'
        - '*WScript.shell*'
        - '* -nop *'
        - '* -noprofile *'
        - '* -decode *'
        - '* -enc *'
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventID=20 Destination IN ("*new-object system.net.webclient).downloadstring(*", "*new-object system.net.webclient).downloadfile(*", "*new-object net.webclient).downloadstring(*", "*new-object net.webclient).downloadfile(*", "* iex(*", "*WScript.shell*", "* -nop *", "* -noprofile *", "* -decode *", "* -enc *")
